stem: Which SOQL clause limits the rows returned?
explanation: LIMIT caps how many rows a query returns, for example LIMIT 50. Use it with ORDER BY so you know which rows you get.

stem: What does a colon before a variable in SOQL, such as :minRevenue, do?

options.text: Binds the Apex variable into the query
Creates a new field on the queried object
Escapes a string so quotes cannot break the query
Starts a subquery against a child relationship

explanation: Bind variables insert Apex values safely.

stem: How do you read a parent field from a child query on Contact?
explanation: Child to parent uses dot notation with the relationship name.

stem: How do you get child Contacts with their parent Account in one query?

options.text: A subquery in the SELECT using the child relationship name Contacts
A JOIN clause between Account and Contact in the FROM clause of the query
A UNION query that combines two separate queries into one result
Contacts.Account in the WHERE clause, which filters by parent

explanation: Parent to child uses a subquery with the plural child relationship name.

stem: For a lookup field Installation__c, what is the relationship name used in queries?
explanation: For a custom lookup called Installation__c, the field holds the Id, while the relationship name is Installation__r. You write Installation__r.Name to read the parent's name.

stem: How many levels of parent relationships can a child-to-parent query traverse?
explanation: You can traverse up to five levels of parents.

stem: Which statement returns a list of lists across several objects?
explanation: SOSL returns a List<List<SObject>>, with one inner list for each object type in the RETURNING clause. SOQL returns a single list.

stem: When is SOSL the right choice?

options.text: Searching text across several objects at once
Reading all of the fields of one object by Id
Doing arithmetic on number fields across records
Counting rows with GROUP BY in a single query

explanation: SOSL searches text across objects. SOQL queries one object.

stem: Which function counts rows in an aggregate SOQL query?
explanation: COUNT and COUNT(field) are aggregate functions.

stem: Which clause filters groups created by GROUP BY?
explanation: HAVING filters aggregate results. WHERE filters rows before grouping.

stem: What is a benefit of a SOQL for loop such as for (Account a : [SELECT Id FROM Account])?

options.text: Records are retrieved in chunks of 200, reducing heap use
It avoids every governor limit, so any number of rows can load
It runs as a batch job in the background after the transaction
It skips sharing rules, so users see rows they normally cannot

explanation: SOQL for loops process records in chunks.

stem: Which DML statement inserts a record if missing and updates it if found, using an external ID?
explanation: Upsert matches on Id or an external ID field.

stem: How many records of the same type can merge combine?
explanation: Merge combines up to three records into one master record.

stem: What is the difference between insert and Database.insert(list, false)?

options.text: The Database method allows partial success and returns results
Insert is asynchronous, so it runs after the transaction
Database.insert ignores validation rules for all records
They are identical, and the second argument has no effect

explanation: With allOrNone false, valid records are saved and errors are returned per record.

stem: Which object do you inspect to see why a record failed with Database.insert?
explanation: SaveResult holds success status and errors for each record.

stem: What is mixed DML in Apex?

options.text: Changing setup and non-setup objects in one transaction
Mixing insert and update on one list in the same call
Using DML and SOQL together in the same method
Using two triggers on the same object in one transaction

explanation: Mixed DML errors occur when setup objects (such as User) and non-setup objects are changed together.

stem: How do you prevent SOQL injection in dynamic queries?

options.text: Remove spaces and special characters from every input value
Convert all user input to uppercase before building the query
Use SOSL instead of SOQL, because SOSL cannot be injected

explanation: Bind variables or escaping stop user input from changing the query.

stem: Which is best practice for DML?

options.text: Collect records in a list and run one DML after the loop
Run DML inside the loop so each record saves straight away
Run DML in a constructor when the class is created
Use SOQL to insert records in a single statement

explanation: One DML on a list uses fewer statements.

stem: What does the ALL ROWS keyword allow in SOQL?
explanation: ALL ROWS includes records in the recycle bin.

stem: Which TWO are DML statements? (Choose 2)
explanation: Upsert and undelete are DML. Select is SOQL and find is SOSL.

stem: A query selects Id and Name only, then the code reads the Industry field from a result. What happens?
explanation: Fields not selected cannot be read and cause an error.

options.text: The number of contacts on the first account, which may be 0
A null value if there are no contacts
An error, because subqueries are not allowed
The total number of contacts in the org

explanation: The child relationship returns a list, which is empty rather than null when there are no children.

stem:
How do you read the count from this query?

    AggregateResult[] r = [SELECT COUNT(Id) total FROM Account];

options.text: r[0].total, reading it as a field
r.size(), which returns the row count of the result

explanation: Aggregate results are read with get and the alias, and the value must be cast to the expected type.
With allOrNone set to false, the valid records are saved and the failing one is reported in its SaveResult.

stem: The same three accounts are inserted with the statement insert accs; and the second record fails validation. What happens?

options.text: A DmlException is thrown and none are saved
Two are saved and one fails quietly

explanation: A plain DML statement is all or nothing. Any failure throws an exception and rolls back the statement.

options.text: SOQL injection; use a bind variable such as :input
A governor limit; replace the query with a SOSL search
Mixed DML; move the update into a future method
Heap size; store the records in a Set instead of a List

explanation: Concatenating user input lets a user change the query. A bind variable in the query, or String.escapeSingleQuotes at minimum, prevents that.
